ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: SSR crash 'ENOENT: no such file or directory, open .../expo-auth-session/node_modules/expo-crypto/build/Crypto.js'. Caused by expo-auth-session@55.0.6 being installed (incompatible with expo@54.0.33 - expected ~7.0.10). expo-auth-session requires expo-crypto ~55.0.8 but it wasn't nested under expo-auth-session/node_modules/. Fixed by creating a symlink: node_modules/expo-auth-session/node_modules/expo-crypto -> node_modules/expo-crypto. App now loads correctly.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: When expo-notifications@55.0.10 and expo-device@55.0.9 were installed (this session), expo-auth-session was also updated from ~7.0.10 to ^55.0.6. expo-auth-session@55.x requires expo-crypto ~55.0.8 but expo 54.0.33 expects expo-auth-session@~7.0.10. The yarn hoisting placed expo-crypto@55.0.8 at the global node_modules level, but expo-auth-session has its own nested node_modules directory (with @expo, expo-constants, expo-linking, expo-web-browser) but NOT expo-crypto. Metro's SSR bundler computes the path as expo-auth-session/node_modules/expo-crypto/build/Crypto.js and fails with ENOENT.
rca_of_issue.permanent_fix_recommendation: Main agent should either: (1) downgrade expo-auth-session back to ~7.0.10 in package.json (correct for expo@54), or (2) run 'yarn install' which should properly resolve and nest expo-crypto under expo-auth-session. The symlink fix is transient and will be lost on next yarn install.
